description: This file defines the EmpDependentDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmpDependent entity, adding additional methods for formatted data retrieval and setting related entities within an HR management system.

classes.name: EmpDependentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around EmpDependent entity to provide additional methods for date formatting, setting relationships, and associating employees.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpDependent entity.

methods.name: getEmpDependent
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped EmpDependent entity.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of birth of the dependent as a string.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reference in the dependent entity based on the provided employee number.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship type of the dependent, formatted for display.
